_about: Queue for scripts/draft-answers.mjs. The monthly job drafts the first `queued` topics in order, marks them `drafted`, and opens a PR. Reorder, add or delete topics freely; `angle` is the brief the drafter works from. Status values: queued, scheduled, drafted, failed, skipped. `scheduled` topics are already written and waiting in scheduled.json for their `release` month; scripts/release-answers.mjs marks them `drafted` when they go out.
